title: ActivationPayload
description: The response returned by GET /activate/{code}. Fetched ONCE when the caregiver enters the 6-digit code, then cached locally (SQLite via GRDB) so the app works 100% offline. Contains the senior-specific configuration the caregiver set up during web signup.

account_id.description: Opaque Master Account identifier. No PII (email, billing) is ever sent to the device.

tier.description: Entitlement tier. Drives custom-contact limits ONLY. The app must never render pricing or upgrade copy (App Store guideline 3.1.3 compliance).

senior_profile.description: Minimal profile for personalizing the senior-facing UI.

display_name.description: Friendly name shown in the app, e.g. 'Mom' or 'Grandpa'. Set by the caregiver.

emergency_contact.description: FEATURE #2 — the 'Call My Person' panic button target. Caregiver-configured. When present, the app shows a large always-visible button that dials this contact directly (never 911). Null if the caregiver did not configure one.

phone.description: E.164, passed to the native dialer.

relationship.description: e.g. 'son', 'daughter', 'neighbor'. Shown under the name for clarity.

photo_url.description: Optional face photo — seniors recognize faces faster than text. Cached on first activation.

custom_contacts.description: FEATURE #15 — local contacts the caregiver PRE-LOADED during web signup so the app is useful on first open (no empty state). Free tier is capped at limits.max_custom_contacts; premium is uncapped.

note.description: Optional caregiver note, e.g. 'Front desk, ask for Maria'.

limits.description: Tier-derived limits. Enforced server-side at signup; mirrored here so the cached app can show a neutral 'list full' state offline WITHOUT mentioning price or upgrades.

max_custom_contacts.description: 3 for free tier; null = unlimited for premium.

issued_at.description: When this payload was generated. Used by the app to decide when to attempt a background refresh.

signature.description: Detached signature over the canonical payload (account_id|tier|issued_at|contacts hash). Lets the app verify the data was not tampered with in transit/cache — the data-integrity backbone of the 'spoof-resistant' claim.
